kids: Watch decorated floats and marching bands
Bring a lawn chair and blanket for the curb
site: Charlotte Performing Arts Center staging area
about: CEO Bob White wrote in the chamber's October 12 column that the parade has brought families, neighbors, businesses and community groups together for nearly five decades.
He described the sidewalks filling with children, holiday music and decorated floats as the heart of the day.
The local calendar lists a judging area in front of Centennial Bank and names the awards, with first through third place in each category plus a Grand Marshal Award and a President Award.
Entry fees for those riding in the parade are $50 for for-profit businesses and $35 for nonprofits, with $5 more per horse, and the registration deadline was November 12.
Parade awards are announced at the chamber's Third Wednesday Coffee on December 16.
faq: When does the Charlotte County Christmas Parade start?
The parade steps off at noon on Saturday, December 12, 2026.
What is the 2026 theme?
Sleigh Bells and Seashells.
Does it cost anything to watch?
No, the listing says the public is invited free of charge.
Where does the parade start and end?
It stages at the Charlotte Performing Arts Center on Carmalita Street and disbands at the Charlotte Harbor Event and Conference Center on Taylor Street.
Will Santa be in the parade?
Yes, the chamber's designated Santa Claus is the only Santa permitted.
Who runs the parade?
The Charlotte County Chamber of Commerce, phone 941-627-2222.

kids: Watch Santa light the Christmas tree
Eat from food trucks at Founder's Square
about: The association's catalog lists the activity code TREEDec26 and registration open from July 1 through December 4.
Babcock Ranch's Facebook page promotes the same Friday, December 4 festival from 5:30 to 9 PM at Founder's Square with food trucks, sparkling lights and holiday cheer.
Sponsors named for the 2026 celebration include Certified Heating and Cooling, Set Exteriors and Park Square Homes.
The association says more holiday magic is on the way throughout December, so families can watch its calendar for later events.
faq: When is the Babcock Ranch Tree Lighting Festival?
Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5:30 to 9 PM.
Where is it?
Founder's Square, 42881 Lake Babcock Drive, Babcock Ranch.
Is there a fee?
The catalog lists a $0.00 fee.
Who lights the tree?
The listing says Santa lights the Christmas tree.
Do we need to register?
Registering is highly encouraged, and an account is required to register.
What should we leave at home?
The association asks that pets stay leashed and under control and that children skip bikes and scooters in the event area.

kids: Hear a story and sip hot cocoa
Meet Santa and pose for photos
site: Winter Yard Sale next door to the fun
about: The Lee County calendar entry pairs Santa Fest with a Winter Yard Sale where families can shop for holiday treasures.
Admission to both is free, and the county points families to its online registration page for Santa Fest.
The county asks families to bring a camera because Santa photos are part of the morning.
The calendar gives the recreation center's address as 9200 Corkscrew Palms Blvd. in Estero, ZIP 33928.
faq: When is Santa Fest in Estero?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 AM to noon.
Where is it held?
Estero Recreation Center, 9200 Corkscrew Palms Blvd.
Is it free?
Yes, admission to Santa Fest and the Winter Yard Sale is free.
Do we need to register?
Yes, pre-registration is required at leeparks.org/register.
What happens at Santa Fest?
Story time, hot cocoa, holiday crafts, holiday shopping and a visit with Santa.
Can we take our own photos?
Yes, the county suggests bringing a camera.
